title: Can I BEAT Spell Chess?
summary: chess.com Spell Chess: before each move a player may cast a spell: Jump (a piece can move through one piece as if it were not there) or Freeze (freezes a 3x3 area so pieces there cannot move). Spells recharge and cannot be used twice in a row. Chaotic tactics; he goes 3-1 over four games.
rules: Before your move you may cast one spell.
Jump spell: placed on a piece; that piece may move through/over a piece in its path this turn as if it weren't there.
Freeze spell: freeze a 3x3 area; pieces in it (both colours) cannot move for the opponent's next turn. Frozen pieces still can't capture a king.
Each spell recharges after 3 turns, and you cannot use the same spell twice in a row (chess.com: limited number of each spell - inferred 5 each).
You can be in 'check' that you can only escape via a freeze on the attacker.
win_condition: Checkmate (king capture threats count through spells).
visual_fx: Green potion icon; ice-blue 3x3 overlay for freeze; jump marker on piece
current_impl_issues: Current impl maps Spell Chess to Crazyhouse-lite (drops) - completely wrong. Needs Jump and Freeze spells with cooldowns.

current_impl.explain: Captured pieces join your hand and can be dropped back on the board. Checkmate the bot to win.
